description: update_user lacks the check that the token's user owns the id; any authenticated user can modify any other user's username, email, about_me and password.
MessageForm message length validator dropped the max=140 bound, so messages of unlimited length are accepted (column is 140 chars).
next parameter only checked to start with '/', so protocol-relative '//evil.com' passes and login redirects off-site.
search next_url uses total >= page*per_page instead of >, off-by-one: shows a Next link to an empty page when results exactly fill the current page.
check_token swallows AttributeError when token_expiration is missing and treats the token as not expired, accepting tokens with no expiry (fails open).
API token generated from md5 of user id and timestamp instead of secrets.token_hex, so tokens are predictable and guessable.
